requirements.description: CRSP daily stock returns, prices, and shares (compounded to monthly returns; also needed for Scholes-Williams daily betas and 3-day announcement returns), covering July 1962 to December 1989 for the main sample
Point-in-time share codes and exchange codes for the NYSE/AMEX common-stock universe filter (shrcd 10/11, exchcd 1/2) with validity windows
Delisting returns so that stocks delisting mid-sample are not dropped with a missing final return (paper is silent on delisting treatment; standard adjustment documented in assumptions.md)

CRSP value-weighted and equal-weighted daily index returns: value-weighted index as market proxy for betas (Table II), market-model regressions (Table III Panel B), and the squared-market-return regression (Section III.D); equal-weighted index for the serial-covariance checks (Section III.C)
Monthly risk-free rate (1-month T-bill) for the market-model excess-return regressions in Table III Panel B (paper: 'interest rate on 1-month Treasury Bill')
CRSP-Compustat link (permno to gvkey) to match stocks to quarterly earnings announcement dates for the Table IX replication (stretch target)
Quarterly earnings announcement dates (RDQ) from the Compustat quarterly industrial file for Table IX (paper: 'COMPUSTAT quarterly industrial database', 1980-1989)
